meta.name: NIRAH — Editorial Atelier
meta.description: Redesign profile for the NIRAH storefront: a warm, editorial shop for a small, hand-checked range of everyday goods. Paper-toned ground, forest ink, a clay accent, a high-contrast serif for display and a quiet grotesk for everything functional. Motion is premium and unhurried, built on GSAP.
source_references: Described style (no image reference): print-magazine editorial layouts, Indian craft-store warmth, the existing NIRAH green brand mark

primary.role: Forest ink: primary buttons, hero ground, footer, active states

secondary.role: Saffron: star ratings, 'New' badges, small highlights on dark ground

accent.role: Clay: one call-to-action emphasis per view, sale prices, offer kickers, italic display accents

neutral.usage: #F3EEE5 page ground; #FBF8F2 raised cards; #E8E1D4 image wells; #1B1A17 primary text (15.6:1 on ground); #5F5A50 secondary text (6.0:1); #8C8577 decoration only

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; light-on-forest for hero, offer and footer bands; every text pair at least 4.5:1

font_families.heading: Instrument Serif (display and section titles only; italic used for one accent word)
font_families.body: Inter (variable, optical size) for UI, body, product names and headings inside functional pages
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono for overlines, indices, counts and SKUs, always uppercase

typography.font_style_notes: High-contrast transitional serif at very large sizes against a neutral grotesk. Serif is never bolded. Mono overlines carry an index number (01 —) to give sections a magazine running order.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large, even section gaps (clamp 5–9rem) separated by hairline rules; dense product grids inside generous sections

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines as editorial rules; no card outlines
shape.divider_style: 1px rgba(27,26,23,0.14) full-width rules that draw in from the left

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused, used only for floating layers (menus, sheets, toasts)
elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers and parallax rather than shadows

motion.easing: CustomEase 'nirah' = cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for 80% of motion; power2.in for exits; none for scrubbed scroll
motion.entrance_pattern: masked rise: text lines slide up from behind a clip, images unveil with clip-path while settling from scale 1.12
motion.exit_pattern: short fade with a 12px drop, power2.in, about 60% of the entrance duration
motion.philosophy: cinematic but restrained: premium personality, no overshoot except the cart badge

components.button_style: Pill buttons; primary is forest ink with paper text and a magnetic pull on fine pointers; secondary is an underlined text link whose rule wipes on hover
components.input_style: Paper-white fields with a hairline border and a forest focus ring
components.card_style: Borderless product cards: 4:5 image well with 10px radius, mono category overline, sans name, tabular price; quick-add sits in the image corner
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed translucent top bar that hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up, with a scroll-progress hairline; floating tab bar on phones
components.modal_style: Existing spring-driven sheets restyled to paper surfaces
components.list_style: Numbered editorial lists with hairline rules
components.component_notes: Section heads pair a mono index (01 —) and overline with a large serif title; one italic clay word per hero headline

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A printed shop catalogue on uncoated paper
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial (2020s independent magazines) with mid-century catalogue numbering

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous; whitespace frames each product like a plate in a catalogue
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy display type top-left, imagery weighted right
visual_language.contrast_level: high for type, low for surfaces
visual_language.texture_usage: flat paper tones; photography provides all texture

composition.flow_direction: Z-pattern on the hero, then vertical with one horizontal pinned chapter (categories)
composition.negative_space_role: Isolates the headline and lets products breathe

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural colour, soft daylight, cropped tight; slight warm wells behind cut-outs
imagery.graphic_elements: hairline rules, mono indices, an italic accent word

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate press scale plus a product image that flies along an arc into the cart
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Images ease in 4%, links wipe an underline, primary buttons lean toward the pointer
interaction_feel.loading_style: Quiet spinner; content enters with masked rises

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Short explanation and one way forward
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific and calm; says what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: If GSAP fails to load, content renders statically with CSS-only reveals; prefers-reduced-motion disables pinning, parallax, scrubbing and the marquee
overview.primary_technology: GSAP 3.13 (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip, ScrollToPlugin, MotionPathPlugin, CustomEase)

background_effects.description: Flat paper ground; depth comes from parallax photography

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: triggered for content reveals; scrubbed for parallax, manifesto word fill, category pin and progress hairline

scroll_morphing.description: Categories chapter pins and converts vertical scroll into horizontal travel on wide screens; deals marquee speeds up with scroll velocity

text_effects.description: Display headings split into masked lines that rise; manifesto split into words that fill from 15% to 100% ink as you scroll; footer wordmark characters rise

cursor_effects.description: Primary CTAs and round icon buttons lean toward fine pointers using gsap.quickTo

image_effects.description: Hero, offer and category banner images unveil with clip-path inset and settle from scale 1.12; product images ease to 1.04 on hover

canvas_drawings.description: The previous fluted-glass canvas hero is retired

svg_animations.description: Section rules draw in from the left; add-to-cart flight follows a MotionPath arc

visual_effects.composite_notes: Every view mounts its animations inside one gsap.context scoped to <main>; the router reverts it before the next view renders, so SplitText, ScrollTriggers and pins never outlive their page. GSAP is loaded from jsDelivr; if it is unavailable the site falls back to the CSS reveal classes.
